editor.summary: Editor readiness, play mode, and Console diagnostics.

scene.summary: Scene discovery, loading, saving, and hierarchy inspection.

objects.summary: Scene GameObjects, components, transforms, and selection.

prefabs.summary: Prefab creation, instantiation, inspection, and direct editing.

capture.summary: Scene/Game View capture and Profiler recording.

control.summary: Registry and REPL session mechanics used by the CLI.

editor/status.selectWhen: Check whether the Unity Editor and play-mode state are ready.
editor/status.avoidWhen: The request is to enter or exit play mode.

editor/playmode.enter.avoidWhen: Only the current Editor state is needed.
limitations: The transition is asynchronous; poll editor/status for completion.

editor/playmode.exit.avoidWhen: Only the current Editor state is needed.
limitations: The transition is asynchronous; poll editor/status for completion.

editor/console.clear.avoidWhen: Existing Console messages must remain available.
limitations: Clearing may be unavailable in restricted Editor contexts.

editor/console.mark.selectWhen: Place a unique log marker before a diagnostic operation.

gameobject/find.selectWhen: Find scene GameObjects by name, tag, or component.
gameobject/find.avoidWhen: The complete scene hierarchy is required.
limitations: Results are bounded; use scene/hierarchy for complete structural inspection.

gameobject/create.selectWhen: Create an empty GameObject or primitive in a loaded scene, optionally under a known parent.
gameobject/create.avoidWhen: An existing prefab asset should be instantiated.

gameobject/destroy.selectWhen: Destroy a GameObject in a loaded scene.
gameobject/destroy.avoidWhen: An asset or prefab-asset child should be deleted.
limitations: The mutation is destructive and cannot be verified from the returned object alone.

gameobject/get.selectWhen: Inspect one GameObject whose selector is supplied or will be bound from a known producer.
gameobject/get.avoidWhen: Do not select or exact-load merely for a hierarchy-wide scan or a future drill-down whose necessity depends on whether an upstream read returns a concrete target. A supplied selector or explicitly requested known-producer consumer is not deferred. Use component/get for serialized fields.

gameobject/modify.selectWhen: Rename a GameObject or change its basic state.
gameobject/modify.avoidWhen: Transform vectors or component fields should change.

gameobject/set_parent.selectWhen: Reparent an existing scene GameObject or move it to a scene root.
gameobject/set_parent.avoidWhen: The object is being created under a known parent (use gameobject/create parentPath), or the target is stored inside a prefab asset.

gameobject/duplicate.selectWhen: Duplicate a GameObject in the current scene.
gameobject/duplicate.avoidWhen: An asset should be copied or a prefab instantiated.

component/add.selectWhen: Add a component to a scene GameObject.
component/add.avoidWhen: The component belongs directly in a prefab asset.

component/remove.selectWhen: Apply an explicitly requested or rule-specified component removal to a scene GameObject.
component/remove.avoidWhen: Do not infer removal from a diagnostic scan. Select or exact-load only when an applicable repair rule requires removal or the user explicitly requests removal. Use prefab/asset_remove_component for a prefab asset.
limitations: The mutation is destructive; verify that the removed component instance is absent from the object's component summaries.

component/get.selectWhen: Inspect one scene component whose selectors are supplied or will be bound from a known producer.
component/get.avoidWhen: Do not select or exact-load merely for a broad scan or a future drill-down whose necessity depends on whether an upstream read returns a concrete target and component. A supplied selector or explicitly requested known-producer consumer is not deferred. Use gameobject/get for component type summaries.
limitations: Serialized property output is bounded.

component/modify.selectWhen: Change serialized fields on a scene component.
component/modify.avoidWhen: GameObject identity or transform properties should change.

transform/set.selectWhen: Move, rotate, or scale a scene GameObject.
transform/set.avoidWhen: A RectTransform or other serialized component field should change.
limitations: Compare floating-point vectors with an appropriate tolerance.

project/selection.get.selectWhen: Inspect the current Unity Editor selection.
project/selection.get.avoidWhen: Objects should be found independently of Editor selection.

project/selection.set.selectWhen: Select scene objects or assets in the Unity Editor.
project/selection.set.avoidWhen: An object only needs to be located.

project/scene.list.selectWhen: List scene assets available in the project.
project/scene.list.avoidWhen: The active scene hierarchy is required.

project/scene.open.selectWhen: Open a specific scene asset, including each scene enumerated for a project-wide scan.
project/scene.open.avoidWhen: The already active scene only needs inspection.
limitations: No built-in independent readback currently proves the loaded-scene set after an additive open.

project/scene.save.selectWhen: Save the active scene to an explicit asset path.
project/scene.save.avoidWhen: A specific non-active loaded scene must be saved.
limitations: When scenePath names a new scene, its parent folder under Assets must already exist.

project/scene.list can confirm that the target scene asset path is listed after saving, but no built-in independent readback proves that an existing scene became clean or that all intended content persisted.

scene/hierarchy.avoidWhen: Scene assets or a prefab-asset hierarchy should be listed.
limitations: Depth and component inclusion directly affect response size.
Use includeComponents=true only for an explicit hierarchy-wide component scan; otherwise keep it false.
Component summaries do not guarantee Missing Script slots or other task-specific markers.

project/asset.list.selectWhen: Find project assets by type, name, or folder.

project/asset.import.selectWhen: Import a newly written asset into Unity.
project/asset.import.avoidWhen: An already imported asset requires a forced update.
limitations: Use project/asset.reimport for an existing imported asset.

project/asset.reimport.selectWhen: Force Unity to reimport an existing asset.
project/asset.reimport.avoidWhen: The asset is newly written and not yet imported.
limitations: The target asset must already exist.

asset/move.avoidWhen: The source asset should remain in place.

asset/copy.selectWhen: Copy an asset while retaining the source.

asset/delete.selectWhen: Delete one or more project assets or folders.
asset/delete.avoidWhen: A GameObject in a loaded scene should be destroyed.
limitations: The mutation is destructive; inspect failedPaths before treating it as complete.

asset/create_folder.selectWhen: Create a folder in the Unity Assets tree.
asset/create_folder.avoidWhen: An operating-system folder outside the project is required.

material/create.avoidWhen: An existing material only needs assignment.
limitations: Missing parent folders under Assets are created automatically; do not pre-create them.

material/get.selectWhen: Inspect a material shader and its properties.
material/get.avoidWhen: A Renderer component's serialized state is required.
limitations: gameObjectPath reads Renderer slot 0 only; higher slots have no built-in material-path proof.

material/assign.selectWhen: Assign an existing material to a Renderer slot.
material/assign.avoidWhen: The material asset itself should be created or edited.
limitations: No generic built-in readback contract guarantees the assigned material path for every Renderer slot.

prefab/create.selectWhen: Create a prefab asset from a scene GameObject.
prefab/create.avoidWhen: An existing prefab should be instantiated.
limitations: Missing parent folders under Assets are created automatically; do not pre-create them.

prefab/instantiate.selectWhen: Instantiate a prefab asset in the active scene.
prefab/instantiate.avoidWhen: A new prefab asset should be created.
limitations: Verify with gameobject/get using the returned instanceId; never predict the instance name or path.

prefab/unpack.selectWhen: Unpack a prefab instance in a loaded scene.
prefab/unpack.avoidWhen: The prefab asset itself should be edited or deleted.
limitations: No built-in independent readback currently exposes the prefab relationship needed to verify unpacking.

prefab/asset_hierarchy.selectWhen: Inspect the hierarchy stored inside a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_hierarchy.avoidWhen: The active scene hierarchy is required.
limitations: Depth directly affects response size.
Component summaries do not guarantee Missing Script slots or other task-specific markers.

prefab/asset_get.selectWhen: Inspect one prefab GameObject whose selectors are supplied or will be bound from a known producer.
prefab/asset_get.avoidWhen: Do not select or exact-load merely for a prefab-wide scan or a future drill-down whose necessity depends on whether an upstream read returns a concrete target. A supplied selector or explicitly requested known-producer consumer is not deferred. Use gameobject/get for a loaded scene instance.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.

prefab/asset_get_component.selectWhen: Inspect one prefab component whose selectors are supplied or will be bound from a known producer.
prefab/asset_get_component.avoidWhen: Do not select or exact-load merely for a broad scan or a future drill-down whose necessity depends on whether an upstream read returns a concrete target and component. A supplied selector or explicitly requested known-producer consumer is not deferred. Use component/get for a loaded scene instance.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.
Serialized property output is bounded.

prefab/asset_modify_component.selectWhen: Modify serialized component fields inside a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_modify_component.avoidWhen: The component belongs to a loaded scene object.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.

prefab/asset_add_component.selectWhen: Add a component directly to a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_add_component.avoidWhen: The target is a loaded scene instance.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.

prefab/asset_remove_component.selectWhen: Apply an explicitly requested or rule-specified component removal directly to a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_remove_component.avoidWhen: Do not infer removal from a diagnostic scan. Select or exact-load only when an applicable repair rule requires removal or the user explicitly requests removal. Use component/remove for a loaded scene instance.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.
The mutation is destructive; verify the remaining prefab component summaries after reload.

prefab/asset_modify_gameobject.selectWhen: Change basic GameObject properties inside a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_modify_gameobject.avoidWhen: A loaded scene instance is the target.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.

prefab/asset_add_gameobject.selectWhen: Add a child GameObject directly inside a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_add_gameobject.avoidWhen: A child should be added to a loaded scene object.
limitations: parentPath is relative to the prefab root; use an empty string for the root and never include the root name.
A newly added child starts with only its Transform component.

prefab/asset_remove_gameobject.selectWhen: Remove a child GameObject directly from a prefab asset.
prefab/asset_remove_gameobject.avoidWhen: A loaded scene GameObject or the prefab root is the target.
limitations: gameObjectPath is relative to the prefab root and never includes the root name.
The prefab root cannot be removed with this command.

screenshot/scene_view.selectWhen: Capture the current Unity Scene View.
screenshot/scene_view.avoidWhen: The Game View or a runtime frame is required.
limitations: Completion requires the output image file to exist.

screenshot/game_view.selectWhen: Capture the Unity Game View or gameplay frame.
screenshot/game_view.avoidWhen: The Scene View editor camera is required.
limitations: Completion requires the output image file to exist.

profiler/stop.avoidWhen: Recorded data only needs to be saved.

profiler/status.selectWhen: Inspect current Unity Profiler recording state.

profiler/save.selectWhen: Save captured Unity Profiler data to a file.
profiler/save.avoidWhen: Profiler recording should start or stop.
limitations: Completion requires the output file to exist and be nonempty.

command/list.selectWhen: Inspect the live command registry through its executable command.

command/registry.snapshot.selectWhen: Fetch package-owned command contracts, optionally conditional on a cached registry generation.
limitations: An unchanged answer carries no contracts; reuse the cached snapshot.

session/list.avoidWhen: Unity scenes or GameObjects should be listed.

session/inspect.selectWhen: Inspect one named C# REPL session.
session/inspect.avoidWhen: A Unity scene object or component is the target.

session/reset.selectWhen: Reset one named C# REPL session.
session/reset.avoidWhen: Unity scene or Editor state should change.
limitations: The named session compiler and executor state are discarded.

denyPolicy.intent: Invoke an arbitrary Unity menu item.
denyPolicy.reason: Arbitrary menu actions can open modal UI or trigger opaque side effects.

denyPolicy.intent: Open an arbitrary Unity Editor window.
denyPolicy.reason: Window automation does not provide a deterministic non-interactive result.
